acceptance.reason: Prefill still slower than existing Q8 at 337 and 961 tokens; whole-model decode has no consistent speedup. Keep opt-in. Kernel attention speedups do not establish model-level speedup.

changes: Precomputed dimension-specific Lloyd-Max tables replace repeated numerical initialization; independent legacy solver parity checks retained.
HVX Hadamard, bounded-error guarded SIMD K/V quantization, complete four-row nibble packing and grouped page allocation.
Fresh prefill uses existing calibrated Q8 HMX attention as temporary computation while persistent KV is packed 4-bit; appended prefill and decode read the packed cache.
Bounded reusable per-session working buffers (96 MiB combined cap), freed on decode/reset/close. Deferred packing owns its input and all data consumers join before reading.
Keep encoded uint16 attention output through folded output projection; exact compact RPC output length; unsupported DSP status recognized in host and Hexagon error domains.
Join contiguous Q/K/V RPC inputs only after validating one live ION allocation; shared K/V supported.
Inline FP16 HMX micro operations on aligned supported DSPs, existing portable path retained.

checks.generation_smoke: Both configurations completed 16 generated tokens for 337 and 961 token prompts, readable output, no crash. No perplexity or task quality claim.

model.name: Gemma4 26B A4B
model.method: Sequential same-device comparisons without clock/thermal locking; two measured builds with equivalent kernel behavior. Report every recorded final run rather than a guaranteed gain.

memory.microbenchmark_note: Payload values include packed page metadata and guards, exclude allocator/pointer table/workspace. FP16 payload excludes scratch. Q8 is a separate calibrated implementation.
memory.model_memory_note: Model peak/RSS includes weights, MoE and workspaces; not a KV-only measurement. Freed KV memory does not automatically increase the fixed expert-cache target.

remaining_work: Fuse 4-bit persistent encoding with existing Q8 prefill calibration/packing or upstream projection/RoPE output to remove duplicate KV scans and intermediate copies; current implementation does not meet zero-prefill-regression requirement.
limitations: Not vLLM kernel bit-equivalence or a reproduction of its production validation.
No full-model 8K/32K prefill benchmark; long-context numbers are attention microbenchmarks.
Temporary Q8 prefill computation changes numerics relative to strict packed-only prefill.
Quality smoke is only 16 generated tokens per prompt.
